# RoadOne IntermodaLogistics

RoadOne IntermodaLogistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. RoadOne IntermodaLogistics employs 567 people (+7.6% YoY, +40 people) and has an annual revenue of $489.3M, founded in 2013. Headquartered in Randolph, Massachusetts, United States, with offices including Tampa, atlanta, baltimore, bloomingdale, and centre. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Mexico.

## About

RoadOne is North America's premier intermodal logistics provider. With over 2,500 trucks at 100+ locations nationwide, and 5 million sq/ft of warehouse & transload space, RoadOne can act as your single source solution providing true port to floor coverage.

RoadOne offers the following solutions nationwide:
-International drayage
-Domestic drayage
-Dedicated fleet and power only solutions
-Container terminal and yard management
-Transload and value add
-National brokerage
